title: Repeat Missed Visit Rate Schedule — Ridgeline Warranty Coverage
content:
**Schedule.** Under Warranty Coverage, the missed visits counted for the registration — the no-show visits recorded on it, the missed visit being billed included — less the warranty plan's free no-show count, give the place of the missed visit among the chargeable ones. The place sets the repeat rate:

| Place among the chargeable missed visits | Repeat rate |
|---|---|
| third or later | 1.5 |
| second | 1.25 |
| first | none — the fee is not raised by a repeat rate |

## The place, step by step within this rule

1. Take the missed visits counted for the registration.
2. Take away the warranty plan's free no-show count.
3. What remains is the place: one is the first chargeable missed visit, two the second, three or more the third or later.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical free no-show count 1)

| Missed visits counted | Place | Repeat rate |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | first | none |
| 3 | second | 1.25 |
| 4 | third | 1.5 |
| 6 | fifth | 1.5 |

With a hypothetical free no-show count of 0, the first missed visit counted is the first chargeable one, the second is the second chargeable one and takes 1.25, and the third takes 1.5.
